items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution this cycle. Highest-leverage friction is control-plane throughput: 10/10 delivery slots occupied, 54 improvements awaiting measurement, 21 failed requests, 7 repairs open, 108 approved proposals without execution, and only 63% approved-proposal execution. Do not create duplicate proposals, telemetry requests, experiments, or queue items. First release one slot by completing or closing the existing repair-or-close case, then admit the preserved affiliate CTA refinement with its existing baseline, validation, measurement window, and rollback. Retain deferred product concepts for execution-integrity/deduplication, capacity-aware admission, measurement-readiness gating, and AI-cost guardrails; implementation requires the existing approval and engineer queue. Keep private launch and security gates unchanged. Revenue claims remain limited to the observed $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21.
